title: Abakhi Beentsika Eziphakamileyo
intro: Umi phambi kwamanxuwa esixeko sakudala esihle, iintsika zaso eziphakamileyo ngoku ziwile. Umoya uvuthuza ezitalatweni ezingenanto, uphethe inkumbulo yabantu abanamandla ababekhe balawula la mazwe. Babengoobani?
clues: Sasingabantu abanamandla amakhulu nezakhono, esaziwa ngezakhiwo zethu ezinkulu kunye nempucuko ephucukileyo.
Sasihlala kwilizwe elineenduli zesanti neenduli ezinamatye, kwaye sasikholelwa ukuba akukho mntu unokusinqoba.
Isithunywa seza kuthi sivela phakathi kwezihlobo zethu, sisibiza ukuba sinqule uAllah yedwa, kodwa samgatya saza samhleka usulu.
Saziqhayisa sathi, ‘Ngubani onamandla kunathi?’ saza saqhubeka nokuzikhukhumalisa nokunqula izithixo.
U-Allah wasithumelela umoya ovuthuzayo owavuthuza ubusuku obusixhenxe neentsuku ezisibhozo, watshabalalisa yonke into.
Sasingabantu baka-'Ad, abakhi be-Iram, kwaye ikamva lethu laba sisilumkiso kubo bonke abalandelayo.

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
